input.title: A quiet South Delhi reset
input.summary: A mostly indoor, low-effort Saturday built around a calm art stop, a pure-veg lunch, and a short cultural finish — kept that way because the air quality is very poor today. I trimmed the outdoor time and kept the pace gentle so it still feels fun without tiring you out.

stops.activity: Do one slow loop by the tombs and sit for a few minutes on a bench before heading out.
stops.why: You said you’re tired and want something fun, and this gives you a light walk early in the day before the worst of the heat/air drag you down.
stops.tradeoff: About 50 min outdoors even though AQI is very poor, but it’s the quietest nearby green space and you’ll get the least crowded hour.

stops.activity: Order a simple pure-veg South Indian lunch and linger over a coffee or buttermilk.
stops.why: It fits your vegetarian preference and gives you an easy, sit-down break right in the lunch window without a hectic crowd scene.

stops.activity: Browse one exhibition floor, then sit in the courtyard with a drink and people-watch for a bit.
stops.why: It keeps the second half indoors and unhurried, which suits being tired while still giving you a cultural stop in South Delhi.
